idea-plugin.name: Merge Conflict Leftover Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags real Git merge-conflict markers (<<<<<<<, the diff3 |||||||, =======, >>>>>>>) left behind in any file -- a real, distinct problem from an active unresolved merge (which the IDE's own Commit window already flags in red): a merge that was already resolved and committed, but with the markers themselves accidentally left in the file.

100% plain-text scan, any file type -- no PSI-per- language dependency, no network calls.

Stated honestly: a <<<<<<< or >>>>>>> line is always flagged, including documentation that cites the literal marker syntax as an example -- a real, accepted trade-off (favoring not missing a genuine leftover marker over filtering out rare documentation false positives). A line of exactly seven = is also a Markdown or reStructuredText title underline, so ======= and ||||||| are only flagged in a file that also has one of the angle-bracket markers.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry.
